title: Fill the form runtime and confirm the summary updates
description: This verifies that a form filler can enter answers in the form runtime and see the preview summary reflect the entered data.

steps.description: Navigate to /runtime/form
Fill in a text field with a valid value
Select a radio option
Select a checkbox option
Select a value from a dropdown
Verify the preview summary reflects the entered data
Verify the form remains in sync with the preview

title: Browse the catalog and open the single-user designer
description: Verifies that a user can open the home catalog and launch the single-user designer example from it.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the route card for the single-user designer example
Verify the designer runtime is displayed
Verify the single-user mode is active

title: Open the viewer runtime from the example catalog
description: This verifies that a demo user can browse the example catalog and launch the viewer runtime from the homepage.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the route card for the viewer runtime
Verify the viewer runtime is displayed
Verify the document is rendered in read-only mode

title: Browse the catalog and open the form runtime
description: Verifies that a user can open the home catalog and launch the form runtime from it.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the route card for the form runtime example
Verify the form runtime is displayed
Verify the template form is available

title: Switch from single-user designer to multi-user designer
description: This verifies that a designer user can open the single-user runtime and switch to the multi-user runtime while continuing to interact with the designer.

steps.description: Navigate to /designer/single-user
Switch to the multi-user designer mode
Interact with the designer canvas
Verify the multi-user designer is displayed
Verify the preview updates after designer interaction

title: Browse the catalog and open the viewer runtime
description: Verifies that a user can open the home catalog and launch the read-only viewer runtime from it.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the route card for the viewer runtime example
Verify the viewer runtime is displayed
Verify the document is shown in read-only mode

title: Review the viewer runtime in read-only mode
description: Verifies that a user can open the viewer runtime, browse document pages, and confirm that editing controls are not available.

steps.description: Navigate to /runtime/viewer
Verify the viewer runtime is displayed
Navigate through the document pages
Verify document pages are rendered in read-only mode
Verify editing affordances are not displayed

title: Browse pages in the viewer runtime
description: This verifies that a viewer can move through the document pages while the content remains visible in read-only mode.

steps.description: Navigate to /runtime/viewer
Navigate to the next page in the viewer
Navigate to another page in the viewer
Verify multiple document pages can be viewed
Verify the document remains read-only

title: Browse the catalog and open the schemas catalog
description: Verifies that a user can open the home catalog and launch the schemas example area from it.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the route card for the schemas example
Verify the schema catalog is displayed
Verify schema families are listed

title: Open the schemas catalog from the example catalog
description: This verifies that a user can browse the example catalog and open the schemas catalog entry.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the route card for the schemas catalog
Verify the schemas catalog is displayed
Verify schema families are listed

title: Edit a schema in the single-user designer and see the preview update
description: This verifies that a designer can modify a schema in single-user mode and observe the preview reflect the change.

steps.description: Navigate to /designer/single-user
Select a schema element in the designer
Edit the selected schema element
Verify the preview updates to reflect the schema change
Verify the designer remains in single-user mode

title: Fill the form and see the preview summary update across the flow
description: Verifies that a user can enter values in the form runtime, navigate through the form, and see the preview summary reflect the entered data.

steps.description: Navigate to /runtime/form
Fill in a text field with a valid value
Change a radio selection
Toggle a checkbox
Select a valid option from a dropdown
Navigate to the next form page
Verify the preview summary reflects the entered form data
Verify the next page content is displayed

title: Open a family-specific schema example
description: This verifies that a user can open a schema family example page from the catalog and reach the family-specific example view.

steps.description: Navigate to /schemas
Click a schema family example link
Verify the family-specific example page is displayed
Verify the selected schema family content is shown

title: Browse schema families and open a family example
description: Verifies that a user can open the schema catalog, browse families, and launch a family-specific example page.

steps.description: Navigate to /schemas
Verify schema families are listed
Open a schema family
Open a family example page
Verify the family example page is displayed
Verify the selected family context is reflected in the page

title: Use repeatable fields in the form runtime
description: This verifies that a form filler can add repeated entries and see them included in the preview summary.

steps.description: Navigate to /runtime/form
Add a repeated field entry
Fill in the repeated field entry with a valid value
Add another repeated field entry
Fill in the second repeated field entry with a valid value
Verify both repeated entries are shown in the preview summary
Verify the repeated field section remains editable

title: Move a schema element in the designer and confirm the preview stays in sync
description: This verifies that a designer can rearrange schema elements and the rendered preview continues to match the current structure.

steps.description: Navigate to /designer/single-user
Select a schema element in the designer
Move the selected schema element
Verify the schema order changes in the designer
Verify the preview updates to match the new order

title: Move a schema in multi-user designer mode and see the preview update
description: Verifies that a user can open the multi-user designer, rearrange a schema item, and observe the preview updating accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /designer/multi-user
Verify the multi-user designer runtime is displayed
Move a schema item to a new position
Verify the preview updates after the move
Verify the schema layout reflects the new order

title: Browse schema families in the schemas catalog
description: This verifies that a user can review available schema families and see the catalog content for exploration.

steps.description: Navigate to /schemas
Scroll through the schema families list
Verify schema families are displayed
Verify family example entries are available

title: Move through multiple form pages and preserve the preview summary
description: This verifies that a form filler can navigate between pages in the form runtime and keep previously entered data reflected in the summary.

steps.description: Navigate to /runtime/form
Fill in a valid answer on the current page
Navigate to the next form page
Fill in a valid answer on the next page
Navigate back to the previous form page
Verify previously entered data is still present in the preview summary
Verify the multi-page form flow is still accessible

title: Add and remove repeatable form fields while keeping the preview in sync
description: Verifies that a user can manage repeatable form fields in the form runtime and see the preview summary stay aligned with the current entries.

steps.description: Navigate to /runtime/form
Add a repeatable field entry
Fill the new repeatable field with a valid value
Remove the repeatable field entry
Verify the preview summary reflects the current repeatable field entries
Verify the repeatable field entry is no longer displayed

title: Browse the schema catalog after opening the home catalog
description: Verifies that a user can open the home catalog and then reach the schema catalog through the example routes.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the route card for the schemas example
Verify the schema catalog is displayed
Verify the catalog provides navigation into schema families

title: Handle an empty value in the form runtime
description: This verifies that a form filler sees validation feedback when leaving a required field empty in the form runtime.

steps.description: Navigate to /runtime/form
Leave a required field empty
Attempt to continue the form flow
Verify a validation error is visible
Verify the form does not advance
